title: Open a second working position
what: People waited for 45 minutes of crew time while freight was moving on the belt. About 2 people were handling whether 5 or 7 were present. Most of the crew stood at the sort end (pick-off): about 4 people there while freight was flowing, 1.5 of them handling at a time.
action: Trial a second pick-off position further up the belt, so more of the crew can reach freight. Cutting the crew to 5 would free only about 1 person for 4 min 40 s in this recording.

title: Keep the belt running
what: The belt stood still 5 times, 4 min 58 s in total. People waited for 14 minutes of crew time during those stops.
action: Find out who stops the belt and why. Start with the longest stop, at 8:51.

title: Keep freight arriving
what: People waited for 11 minutes of crew time at an empty, running belt.
action: Look at the unloading end feeding the belt, which is outside this camera's view, for the same periods.
